stem:
Shreya finds a laboratory thermometer in her school lab in Bengaluru. Its scale is marked from −10 °C to 110 °C. Between the 0 °C and 10 °C marks there are 5 equal small divisions.

What are the range and the value of the smallest division?

options.text: Range −10 °C to 110 °C; with 5 divisions each division measures 10 °C
Smallest division is 10 °C because the printed numbers go up in tens

teacher.key_rationale: Range is the marked endpoints −10 °C to 110 °C. From 0 to 10 °C with 5 small divisions, each is 2 °C. Ignoring the true endpoints, reversing the division arithmetic, or reading only the printed tens are traps.
